title: Mean Frank and Crazy Tony
writer: Luciano Vincenzoni, Sergio Donati, Nicola Badalucco
actors: Lee Van Cleef, Tony Lo Bianco, Edwige Fenech
plot: This is a buddy film with a small-time thug (Victor Lobianco) meeting a high-profile gangster (Lee Van Cleef) while in prison. The pair team up to attempt a prison breakout.
